description: In common/mod.rs parse_mdns (lines 2522-2529), the parsed Mdn is constructed by building a serde_json::json!({...}) template and deserializing it. This template enumerates specific field names. If Mdn gains a new field in the future, it will not appear in this template and will be silently absent in the returned value. This is a structural consequence of Mdn being #[non_exhaustive] (preventing struct literal construction), but the risk is undocumented at the construction site. By contrast, send_mdns (lines 2399-2445) uses serde_json::to_value(&mdn) to start from the client-supplied value, which does preserve all existing fields. The parse path has no equivalent preservation guarantee.
title: mdn parse_mdns hand-built JSON template silently drops new Mdn fields
